tagline: 柯达取景器相机，1999 年发布
description: 柯达于1999年推出的取景器相机。配备30mm f/8, 2-element aspheric lens。快门速度1/100 sec.。使用135 (ISO 100/200/400 with DX coding)。4ft (1.2m)。

specs.英文简介: Kodak KB18 is a 35mm camera produced by Kodak in 1999[https://web.archive.org/web/20100215013422/http://www.kodak.com/global/en/consumer/products/pdf/kb18.pdf PDF manual] (archived) copyright date as part of their KB series.
